items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: when I got this break to, to, to leave Mac Shandler, then I joined him

ctx.x: Is that where you took, uh, Dizzy Gillespie's place with Billy Eckstein?

That's right. That's right. That's where I took Dizzy Gillespie's place. You see? And that's when I got sick, see? Yeah. That's where, uh, matter of fact, at that time, when we was playing the Regal Theater, Dizzy Gillespie was, they had the first seat in the audience, and, uh, and, uh, Charlie Parker, with Charlie Parker, he was behind, he was behind stage with us. He had cam in our dressing room, you know? And was, uh, talking with us. See? Well, that was, that was when I took, uh, Dizzy Gillespie's place, uh,…
Parker had been in the band, too, as Billy Eckstein did.
